public class DComposite extends AbstractDComposite
A description of a composite, a composition of primitives. In future perhaps composites containing composites will be implemented.

  • Constructor Details

    • DComposite

      public DComposite(CyclicMap<Placeholder.Handle,Placeholder> cursors)
      Instantiates a new described composite.
      Parameters:
      holders - The components of this composite together with their baselines and locations amongst other things in placeholder objects.
      codepoint - The codepoint assigned to this described composite. That codepoint is decide upon by the user but should not conflict with the UTF codepoints.
      See Also:
      • Placeholder

    • DComposite

      public DComposite(CyclicMap<Placeholder.Handle,Placeholder> components, int codepoint)
      Instantiates a new described composite.
      Parameters:
      components - The components of this composite together primarily with their baselines and locations contained by a placeholder.
      codepoint - The codepoint assigned to this described composite. That codepoint is decide upon by the user but should not conflict with the UTF codepoints.
      See Also:
      • Placeholder

    • parseComponents

      public static CyclicMap<Placeholder.Handle,Placeholder> parseComponents(String codepoints, String baselines)
      Constructs a list of placeholders from two text strings, the placeholders should be passed on composite constructors.
      Parameters:
      codepoints - A string of all components (utf) codepoints, integers interspaced with blanks.
      baselines - The string of all the component's coordinates given in tripples (x,y,baseline), all integers interspaced with blanks.
      Returns:
      A list of plasceholders for the components.
      See Also:
      • Placeholder
